export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/eco-export) states "Total Shipments 163 Records detected", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; exact row quoted: "2026-02-28 | ECO EXPORT | TO THE ORDER OF | 5% IR 64 PARBOILED RICE 50KG BOPP BAG- | HAZIRA PORT SURAT INHZA1, India | Lome, TOGO | 10063019 | BOL 1137181". Further rows seen: 2026-02-26 Nhava Sheva Sea -> Lome, Togo, HS 10063019, BOL 1052329; 2026-02-25 Nhava Sheva Sea -> Lome, Togo, HS 10063019, BOL 1011880; 2026-02-18 Mundra Sea -> Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, HS 10082920 (green millet animal feed), BOL 9774167; 2026-02-17 Nhava Sheva Sea -> Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, HS 10079000 (sorghum machine clean), BOL 9738031. Registered address on record: "C-112, TITANIUM CITY CENTER, NR. SACHIN TOWER, ANANDNAGAR ROAD" (Ahmedabad, Gujarat).
note: Real export shipments are confirmed by dated customs/B-L rows (Feb 2026, Togo and Saudi Arabia), so this is not a declared-only case. However the actual shipped HS codes are 1006 (rice), 1008 and 1007 (millets/sorghum) — the declared HS 190430 (crispbread) is NOT supported by any observed record; per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground, the code should be corrected to the factual one (10063019 rice as the dominant line) and the verdict treated as accepted_hs_corrected. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be verified: DuckDuckGo search returned a connection error on both attempts and volza.com returned HTTP 403, so domestic_status is unknown, not none_found. Revenue and export volume figures are not public on the free views — left null, not estimated. Caveat: 'ECO EXPORT' is a generic trade name; the ImportKey record is matched on name and the Ahmedabad address only, and a separate ImportKey entity 'ECO EXPORTS' (GRFL ICD Sahnewal -> Vancouver, Canada, cleaning products, HS 34029099/42029900, 13 records, latest 2025-05-22) is a different company and was excluded. Legal form, CIN and PAN are not public in the sources seen — null.
